468:t_011:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「You who inherit $$ゼウス$$' soul! Fall into darkness!」

468:t_013:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「That was magnificent, Lord $$ハーデス$$!」

468:t_013:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Stay alert, $$ガラダブラ$$. They are coming.」

468:t_014:3.en:
$$凱$$
「That idiot...! Did he rush off alone when he learned $$ガラダブラ$$ had come back?!」

468:t_014:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$甲児$$ hasn't just passed out...! Someone is sealing away his consciousness!」

468:t_014:7.en:
$$ボス$$
「What the hell does that mean?!」

468:t_014:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「I can sense it...! A dark, rotten stench!」

468:t_014:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Whoever's possessing $$マジンガー$$, show your damn face!!」

468:t_014:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「You sensed me? I shall commend you for that, at least.」

468:t_014:12.en:
$$隼人$$
「It's the vengeful spirit of $$ハーデス$$, whom we defeated!」

468:t_014:13.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Precisely! I am now the $$闇の帝王$$!」

468:t_014:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「D-Darkness and an emperor?! He's an evil boss by a mile!!」

468:t_014:16.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「D-Darkness and an emperor?! He's an evil boss by a mile!!」

468:t_014:17.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「D-Darkness and an emperor?! He's an evil boss by a mile!!」

468:t_014:18.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're possessing $$甲児$$ and sealing off $$マジンガー$$'s power!」

468:t_014:19.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It would be troublesome if his power of light awakened.」

468:t_014:20.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Now, $$ガラダブラ$$! Draw strength from the hatred filling this land!」

468:t_015:0.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Oh! My blood, my flesh, are in the world of the living once more!」

468:t_015:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Is this the power of Lord $$ハーデス$$, king of the underworld?!」

468:t_015:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Now we can fight again! We can avenge ourselves on those loathsome humans!」

468:t_015:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Unlike the $$ミケーネ$$ survivors we met at the galactic center, these ones seem to have risen from the depths of hell!」

468:t_015:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Hold on! Does that mean everything we fought for in the $$時獄戦役$$ was for nothing?!」

468:t_015:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hahahahaha! This is the eternity of gods, higher-dimensional life-forms!」

468:t_015:7.en:
$$號$$
「$$ハーデス$$ is behind all of this!」

468:t_015:8.en:
$$凱$$
「Unless we beat him, will this war with $$ミケーネ$$ go on forever?!」

468:t_015:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「$$ガラダブラ$$! Leave this to us and heal your wounds!」

468:t_015:10.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Understood! I leave it to you, my brethren!」

468:t_016:1.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「It's no use, $$さやか$$! $$マジンガー$$ is under the control of $$ハーデス$$' power now!」

468:t_016:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「No...! Then what are we supposed to do?!」

468:t_016:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「First, we'll defeat those grotesque gods and recover $$マジンガー$$.」

468:t_017:0.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「Um, $$竜馬$$... It's great you're eager to fight, but aren't you going too far forward...?」

468:t_017:1.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「And we're glad you picked us, but $$ボロット$$ will only hold back $$真ゲッター$$...」

468:t_017:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry. I'll do the fighting, so I'm counting on you to handle supplies in the rear.」

468:t_017:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「That's fine, but... Why are you being this reckless?」

468:t_017:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, begin the attack. And stay on your guard against the $$ミケーネ神$$s.」

468:t_017:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Self-proclaimed though they may be, our foes are gods. We cannot underestimate their power.」

468:t_017:8.en:
$$メール$$
「Honestly...! Where did $n go at a time like this?!」

468:t_017:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「He ain't the kind of guy who wastes his time...! He's fighting somewhere, I'm sure!」

468:t_017:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, $$ミケーネ$$! This time, I'll sink you into the deepest pit of hell so you can't crawl back out!!」

468:t_017:11.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hahahahaha! Struggle, humans! You have no chance of victory on this land filled with $$ミケーネ$$'s hatred!!」

468:t_018:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I feel an abnormal exhaustion all over... Is this the power of hatred they spoke of?」

468:t_018:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn it! What a miserable bunch!」

468:t_018:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Hahahahaha, humans! Offer your souls to me!」

468:t_020:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「If we keep this up, we might pull through...!」

468:t_021:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I have kept you waiting, humans! From here on, the hero $$ガラダブラ$$ will face you once more!」

468:t_021:1.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You already passed that title on to us!」

468:t_021:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Now that my body has been restored, it is only right that you return it to me.」

468:t_021:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「You call yourself a hero, but you're just petty!」

468:t_021:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「This isn't the time for that!」

468:t_021:5.en:
$$凱$$
「We're in trouble! We've been pushing our machines too hard to get $$甲児$$ back!」

468:t_021:6.en:
$$渓$$
「Without $$マジンガー$$ or $$ジェニオン$$, this is too much for us...!」

468:t_021:8.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It's useless, girl! His power of light is now imprisoned in my darkness!」

468:t_021:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Wake the hell up, $$甲児$$!! You aren't the kind of man whose story ends here!」

468:t_022:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「You! Where the hell have you been while we're up to our necks in this?!」

468:t_022:2.en:
$n
「I'll explain later! For now, the proprietress is safe!」

468:t_022:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「You mean the proprietress of $$くろがね屋$$...?!」

468:t_023:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「What are you planning to do?!」
